profile.headline: Software Engineer at American Express
profile.summary:
Our live's are always filled with problems. Obstacles, that when solved, can improve us as people and can improve the lives of people around us. These problems are my lifeblood, and solving them is where I thrive.

Programs and software exists as catalysts to solving life's problems. Whether its a simple timer program or building an entirely new and exciting virtual world, I love building the solution to problems. That's how I see programming, as building. Much like carpentry, you must take each task or problem and break it down into the individual parts to solve. So a programmer's job breaks down to how to solve several small problems and tie the entire thing back together to a program that helps make's people's lives a little easier and their problems a little less daunting.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Cloud Computing · ASP.NET · Kubernetes · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Consult with clients on how to design and operate new technologies to solve client issues.

Specifically worked in .NET, Razor, web development, RabbitMQ, and JMeter.

positions.title: Head Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: As the Head Graduate Teaching Assistant for the College of Computer Science and Software Engineering at Kennesaw State University I lead a team of Graduate Teaching Assistants in teaching the lab portion of first and second semester programming students. In these labs, we teach the fundamentals of programming and how to apply those concepts to real world, runnable programs. As the Head Graduate Teaching Assistant, I coordinate with and manage my team of Graduate Teaching Assistants making sure that everyone is on track, teaching what they should, and handling any issues that might arise.

positions.title: Game Host
positions.description: Hosted games, helped customers, played characters, and repaired issues

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: helped customers find their passions, worked a POS, handled and cared for musical instruments
